$note: Ol Pejeta Conservancy (OPC) Tariff Guide - new source, not previously captured. Relevant for any Laikipia-area itinerary (Ol Pejeta is one of the airstrips/destinations already referenced in the Airvan/Governors/ALS flight data - e.g. Governors' 'Ol Pejeta (Komok)' routes, ALS's Wilson-Nanyuki/Samburu/Lewa/Loisaba network).

source.title: Ol Pejeta Conservancy Tariff Guide, January 2025 - December 2025
source.note: Dated for calendar year 2025 despite sitting in the 2026 folder tree - likely the most recent version on file; a 2026 OPC tariff guide may exist and hasn't been checked/found in this folder.

currency: Mixed KES/USD by category (see per-line breakdown).
vatNote: Rates inclusive of VAT. Rates subject to change without notice.
bookingNote: Conservancy gates are CASHLESS - entry tickets must be booked online at https://bookings.olpejetaconservancy.org/.

conservancyEntryFees.unit: per person per entry (daily fee = single entrance for day-trippers, or 24hrs for overnight guests)

student.note: Requires pre-booking for concession rate; groups without a booking reference pay the daily entrance rate. Groups must be 10+ pax with a teacher/institution letter; 2 teachers per group admitted free.

runProperties.note: Ol Pejeta-operated in-house lodging (as distinct from independently-run lodges/camps ON Ol Pejeta - see accommodationRatesNote below).

pelicanHouseCatered.unit: per person per night, Non-Resident unless noted

eaCitizenResidentFlatRate.note: East African Citizens/Residents pay a flat KSH 5,000 per person for the catered option regardless of group size, unlike the Non-Resident per-pax-tier structure.

stables.unit: per room per night, Resident & Non-Resident rates (no citizen/EA split stated for this product)

camping.unit: per person per night, Resident & Non-Resident

accommodationRatesNote: For all independently-run lodges and camps ON Ol Pejeta (i.e. not the 'Run Properties' above), the source directs readers to https://www.olpejetaconservancy.org/ol-pejeta-escapes - no rates for third-party lodges given in this document. Not extracted here - would need a separate lookup if a specific Ol Pejeta lodge (not Pelican House/Stables/camping) is quoted.

notes: Items marked with a minimum-pax requirement (Lion Tracking, Night Game Drive) need 2+ people.
Maximum 6 vehicles allowed at any wildlife sighting, 10 min max per vehicle.
Shared vehicles provided for Night Game Drives and Lion Tracking only; other experiences need separately-arranged transport at extra cost.
Book experiences at least 1 day ahead - subject to weather/availability; activities may change based on animal health/welfare.

gateTimesAndAccess.gateTimes: 7am-7pm daily, entry/exit strictly through Rongai and Serat gates.
gateTimesAndAccess.proofOfResidencyRequired: East African Citizen: national ID or valid passport. East African Resident: valid passport showing work permit or alien certificate.
